title: BattryLeaf's 3x3 hotbar
description: Converts your Minecraft hotbar into a clean 3×3 grid. perfect for MMO mouse users and faster item access.
body:
## ⚠️ Development Over
I cannot do this anymore... lack of funds and I am just done. its just too hard especially beacause i have never coded before. This project is hereby DISCOUNTINUED. [small chances that i get back to it later. take it like a grain of salt tho]. Moving on to other projects.

---

## 🧩 What This Mod Does
BattryLeaf's 3x3 hotbar replaces the standard 1×9 Minecraft hotbar with a **3×3 grid layout**.

This makes item selection more intuitive, especially for players using MMO mice or those who prefer a more compact and visual layout.

---

## ✨ Features
- Converts hotbar into a 3×3 grid
- Designed for MMO mouse users (mapped buttons feel more natural)
- Cleaner and more organized item layout
- Lightweight and client-side

---

## 🎮 Why Use This Mod?
The default hotbar can feel limiting when using multiple keybinds.  
This mod improves:
- Muscle memory for MMO mouse users
- Faster item selection
- Better visual grouping of items

---

## ⚠️ Compatibility & Notes
- Made for Minecraft 1.21.1-11
- Other versions may not be supported (for now)
- This is an early release bugs and UI issues may occur

---

## 👤 Developer Note
I'm actively learning and improving this mod over time. Feedback is appreciated
Also special thanks to ChatGPT and Claude for helping me improve the code
